**Static class** in the `Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Cups](/docs/reference/#latiprimerecups) package.

```csharp
public static class LatiprimereCupsServiceCollectionExtensions
```

Registers the CUPS print system with a dependency injection container.

## Methods

### AddLatiprimereCups

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddLatiprimereCups(this IServiceCollection services, Action<CupsOptions>? configure = null)
```

Registers the CUPS print system. Use together with `AddLatiprimere()` from the Latiprimere package.

**Parameters**

- `services`: The service collection to add to.
- `configure`: Configures how to connect to CUPS, or `null` for the defaults.

**Returns**

The same service collection, for chaining.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): `services` is `null`.
- [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception): [CupsOptions.Server](/docs/reference/latiprimere-cups/cupsoptions/#server) isn't a socket path or host\[:port\], or [CupsOptions.Credentials](/docs/reference/latiprimere-cups/cupsoptions/#credentials) has no user name, or one containing a colon.
